scope: Independent actual-pixel inspection of original090, final front/profile renders and V6/V7 comparisons. No candidate edits, engine tests, calibrated landmark fitting or art approval.
improvements: Wider visible eye openings and less abrupt cheek transitions improve the front over V6.
Nasal recesses are visible instead of the previous indistinct nasal shading.
Hair direction is less uniformly swept and side tufts have more variation.

remaining.finding: Front and profile expose large smooth cap patches and open crown seams. Thick rounded ribbon clumps and sparse temple/back coverage differ strongly from the source irregular, closely layered strands.
remaining.nextRepair: Close crown coverage with overlapping root placement; replace thick isolated ribbons with thinner tapered clump groups and restore temporal/occipital silhouette before adding microdetail.

remaining.finding: Front eyes remain flat almond cutouts with excessive continuous visible whites; the profile shows a bright white eye disk instead of a seated, partly occluded eye. Brow/upper-lid depth and surrounding orbital planes remain generic.
remaining.nextRepair: Seat sclera/iris within the orbital opening and wrap lids around the globe in depth. Judge profile occlusion and iris seating before final eye size.

remaining.finding: The profile nose still forms a pointed wedge, with weak tip/alar separation. Lip/chin contour is soft and pinched; front lower face tapers more abruptly than the source. Nostril marks alone do not recover the source anatomy.
remaining.nextRepair: Fit bridge, tip, ala, philtrum and chin as a connected profile contour; restore distinct cheek/jaw planes and source lower-face width.

remaining.finding: Ear remains a simple polygonal rim and broad cavity. Smooth skin and uniform black hair do not match the reference material variation.
remaining.nextRepair: Address visible ear folds and material variation after primary silhouette/anatomy repair.

decision: Do not run a full 19-view acceptance set or promote the character based on this focused diagnostic. Continue primary face/hair geometry repair.
limitations: Only two final rendered views; no full body, animation appearance, facial-expression or final rig/collision-fit review.
Comparison lighting/cameras are not calibrated; no exact numerical facial proportion claims.
